title: HtmlInputMonth
responsibility: Renders the native input control with type month without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlInputMonth.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte Snippet that the component destructures out of its props, so it is never spread onto the input as an attribute. The markup never references it, so passing a snippet has no effect on the rendered input.

outputs.name: HtmlInputMonth
outputs.description: The native input element rendered directly with no wrapper; every prop except children is spread onto it as an attribute. The type attribute is set to 'month' after the spread, so any type the caller passes is overridden, and the markup body is empty so no child content is rendered.
